name: self-improve
description: [skills] [hooks] Self-improving harness so Claude Code does not repeat the same mistake: hooks log failure signals (tool failures, corrections, guard denials, failed verification), write episode notes and ask Claude for one-line improvement candidates at the end of a turn; a scheduled /self-improve:auto-improve turns causes seen in two or more sessions into trial rules and trial skills kept outside the repo and reports them at the next session start; people review, keep, remove or promote them with /self-improve:review and /self-improve:retro. Guards forbidden operations and asks before harness files change. Node.js only, no network
